name: nevabridge-electron-example
description: Example: the NevaBridge web chat in an Electron application

scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd ../../sdk/typescript build && bun run --cwd ../../widgets/electron build
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R renderer dist/renderer && cp ../../widgets/webview-chat/nevabridge-mark.svg dist/renderer/ && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:electron --external:@nevabridge/electron --outfile=dist/main.cjs && esbuild src/app-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/app-preload.cjs
scripts.start: bun run build:packages && bun run build && bun scripts/launch.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src renderer scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json
